title: Private min pack: optional Grafana provisioning hooks + ConfigMaps/Secrets layout (values-driven)
author: Bruno Silva
description:
Context: Private observability minimum pack needs a consistent way to drop in Grafana dashboards + datasources when customers choose to run Grafana in-cluster, while also supporting customer-managed Grafana where we only ship the artifacts.

This PR adds optional Grafana provisioning hooks to the Private Helm chart(s) with a values.yaml-driven layout for ConfigMaps/Secrets. The goal is to make the installer able to render the same structure across VPC and on-prem, and let Solutions/SRE validate a "supported" baseline without bespoke wiring.

Key changes (high level): (1) Add `observability.grafana.enabled` (default false) that, when true, creates ConfigMaps for Grafana provisioning: datasources + dashboards provider + dashboard JSON bundle mounting. (2) Add a consistent naming + labels/annotations scheme so the private installer and validation harness can discover what was installed. (3) Add Secret references for credentials without ever embedding secrets in values or ConfigMaps (security review driven). (4) Add support for "external Grafana" mode where we still render/export the provisioning ConfigMaps (optional) without deploying a Grafana Deployment/Service.

Values interface (new): - `observability.grafana.enabled`: bool (default false) - `observability.grafana.mode`: "inCluster" | "external" (default "external" when enabled=false; when enabled=true defaults to "inCluster") - `observability.grafana.admin.existingSecret`: name of pre-created secret containing admin creds (required for inCluster) - `observability.grafana.provisioning.dashboards.configMapNameOverride`: optional override for ConfigMap name (otherwise chart-managed) - `observability.grafana.provisioning.dashboards.folder`: default "Redwood Private" - `observability.grafana.provisioning.datasources.prometheus.url`: default `http://prometheus-operated.monitoring.svc:9090` (can be overridden)

Example snippet:

```yaml
observability:
  grafana:
    enabled: true
    mode: inCluster
    admin:
      existingSecret: redwood-grafana-admin
    provisioning:
      dashboards:
        folder: "Redwood Private"
      datasources:
        prometheus:
          url: "http://prometheus-operated.monitoring.svc:9090"
```

Security notes: - No default admin password generation in chart (requested by Security). - No dashboards/datasources content includes tokens/headers; datasource auth is expected to be network/RBAC based for the minimal pack. - ConfigMaps are immutable by default (`immutable: true`) behind a toggle to reduce accidental drift; we add a checksum annotation on the Grafana Deployment so changes roll.

Operational notes: - This does not include the dashboard JSON content itself (that lives in observability-pack); this PR only adds the hooks/mount points and naming conventions the installer uses to inject the bundle. - Backwards compatible: when `observability.grafana.enabled=false`, the chart renders no Grafana resources and behaves as before.

Testing: - `helm template` + chart unit tests for all matrix combinations: enabled/disabled, inCluster/external, secret provided/missing. - Lint checks for forbidden keys (accidental inline secrets).

Follow-ups: - ENG-2843 adds PrometheusRule resources (separate PR). - redwood-private-installer will pin the pack version and pass the bundle artifacts into these ConfigMaps.

Refs: ENG-2842, PM-612; internal issue INT-1184 (Grafana provisioning failing due to RBAC / missing secret expectations).

charts/redwood-private: add grafana provisioning ConfigMaps (datasources + dashboards providers)
charts/redwood-private: add optional in-cluster Grafana Deployment/ServiceAccount/RBAC

conversation: Allison Grant (reviewer) — 2025-02-19: Overall direction looks good. Two asks: (1) can we standardize labels/annotations so the installer can reliably find the ConfigMaps? (e.g., `redwood.ai/observability-pack=true` + version), and (2) please ensure the dashboards folder name is stable across upgrades.

Bruno Silva (author) — 2025-02-19: Added `redwood.ai/observability-pack: "private-min"` and `redwood.ai/observability-pack-version` passthrough label on ConfigMaps + Deployment. Folder default set to `Redwood Private` and documented as stable; can override via values.

Marcus Lin (reviewer) — 2025-02-20: Security: do not generate any admin creds in chart, and don’t support `adminPassword` in values. Require existingSecret when deploying Grafana. Also set `automountServiceAccountToken: false` unless the pod actually needs it.

Bruno Silva (author) — 2025-02-20: Removed `adminPassword` value entirely and updated schema to fail if `existingSecret` missing in `inCluster` mode. Set `automountServiceAccountToken: false` on the Grafana SA and pod. Grafana still needs Kubernetes API? It does not in our config, so safe.

Sergio Costa (reviewer) — 2025-02-21: On the dashboard provider config: can you ensure the mount path matches what observability-pack is going to produce? Also, can we make ConfigMaps `immutable: true` to reduce drift?

Bruno Silva (author) — 2025-02-21: Synced the mount path to `/etc/grafana/provisioning` and `/var/lib/grafana/dashboards/redwood-private` (provider points there). Added `immutable: true` behind `observability.grafana.provisioning.immutableConfigMaps` (default true).
Fatima Noor (reviewer) — 2025-02-22: On-prem/airgap: please avoid any implicit image tags. Do we pin grafana image tag? Also ensure this works when customer’s registry is mirrored.

Bruno Silva (author) — 2025-02-22: Grafana image is values-driven with no default registry override; documented `global.imageRegistry` usage and added schema validation to require an explicit tag when `enabled=true` (we had a floating tag previously in another subchart).

Sean Gallagher (reviewer) — 2025-02-23: SRE: add checksum annotations for *all* provisioning config inputs so we don’t end up with stale dashboards after an upgrade. Also, can you add a NOTES.txt line explaining which resources should exist when enabled?

Bruno Silva (author) — 2025-02-23: Added checksum for each ConfigMap + the existingSecret name (not contents) to trigger rollout. Added NOTES output with a quick sanity checklist and pointers to validation command (installer side).
Colin O'Donnell (reviewer) — 2025-02-24: RBAC: the Role currently includes configmaps list/watch in the namespace. Do we actually need that? If not, reduce permissions.

Bruno Silva (author) — 2025-02-24: Good catch — Grafana does not need to list/watch ConfigMaps for provisioning; it reads from mounted volumes. Removed configmap permissions entirely; kept only what is needed for pod operation (none beyond default).
Allison Grant (reviewer) — 2025-02-24: Approved. Please ensure CHANGELOG entry is explicit that Grafana provisioning is optional and off by default.
Marcus Lin (reviewer) — 2025-02-24: Approved after secret-in-values removal + automount token change.
release_notes: Private Helm charts: added optional Grafana provisioning hooks for the Private observability minimum pack (off by default).
Security: removed support for inline Grafana admin credentials in values; require pre-created Secret when deploying Grafana in-cluster.
